# Appendix

## Q7 (ethical clearance), part 2: What ethics committees were named

The data for this question was extracted using an automated search of the PDFs.

```{r named_committees, include=FALSE}
# \w is any word of either case
comm_pattern1 = c('(obtained |reviewed| approved |approval |granted )?(from |by )?(the )?( \\w+)?( \\w+)?( \\w+)?( \\w+)?( (h|H)uman)?( (R|r)esearch)? (e|E)thics (c|C)ommittee( approved)?( of| at)?( the)?( \\w+)?( \\w+)?( \\w+)?( \\w+)?')
comm_pattern2 = c('(obtained |reviewed| approved |approval |granted )?(from |by )?(the )?( \\w+)?( \\w+)?( \\w+)?( \\w+)? (I|i)nstitutional (R|r)eview (B|b)oard( of| at)?( the)?( \\w+)?( \\w+)?( \\w+)?( \\w+)?')
comm_patterns = paste(c(comm_pattern1, comm_pattern2), collapse='|')
# extract text
ethics_counts = filter(auto_data, ethics_text != '') %>%
  mutate(name = str_remove_all(ethics_text, "-|,|;|'|\\(|\\)"), # remove brackets and apostrophes and other grammatical marks (not full-stops)
         name = str_squish(name),
         name = str_extract_all(name, pattern = comm_patterns), # used _all because of multiple mentions
         name = tolower(name),
         name = str_remove_all(name, 'and performed in|approved this study and all|which follows ethical guidelines|(were|was) conducted|all participants|was obtained prior to|which covered permission for|in the spirit of|(seek |sought )?consent from|informed consent|all athletes provided|(was )?obtained from|(was )?(granted|approved) by|(committee|approval|hrec|project) (id|number|no)'), # remove common words that are not needed
         name = str_remove_all(name, '\\b[a-z]{1,4}[0-9]{1,9}\\b'), # remove HREC numbers
         name = str_remove_all(name, ' [0-9]{1,9}\\b'), # remove HREC numbers
         name = str_remove(name, '| [a-z][a-z]? $'), # unimportant words at end
         name = str_replace_all(name, "universitys", "university's"), # add back apostrophe
         name = str_replace_all(name, '\\bais\\b',' Australian Institute Of Sport '), # expand acronym
         name = str_replace_all(name, '\\bnres\\b',' NRES '), # capitalise acronym
         name = str_squish(name),
         name = str_remove_all(name, '^the | the$'), # remove some common starts and ends
         name = str_remove_all(name, '^from | from$'),
         name = str_remove_all(name, '^and | and$'),
         name = str_remove_all(name, '^by | by$'),
         name = str_remove_all(name, '^to | to$'),
         name = ifelse(str_detect(name, '^character'), '', name), # 
         #name = str_remove(name, 'c\\(. '), # remove characters added due to multiple committees - not working
         name = str_squish(name),
         name = str_to_title(name)) %>% # back to title case
  filter(name !='')
```

#### Where one committee was extracted

```{r results='asis'}
list_select = filter(ethics_counts, !str_detect(name, '\\"')) %>%
  arrange(name)
n_list = nrow(list_select)
for (k in 1:n_list){
  cat('• ', list_select$name[k], '\n\n', sep='')
}
```

#### Where multiple committees were extracted

```{r results='asis'}
list_select = filter(ethics_counts, str_detect(name, '\\"')) %>%
  arrange(name)
n_list = nrow(list_select)
for (k in 1:n_list){
  cat('• ', list_select$name[k], '\n\n', sep='')
}
```
